name: Finance Cashflow Management
description: A dated external thirteen-week forecast packet with safe evidence/proof refs, uncertainty, exception state, and tax-estimate handoff readiness.
audience: Solo entrepreneurs preparing a rolling external cashflow view without delegating money movement
problem: Cashflow planning is easy to neglect when balances, invoices, expected payments, and operating assumptions are scattered.
outcome: A dated external thirteen-week forecast packet with safe evidence/proof refs, uncertainty, exception state, and tax-estimate handoff readiness.
whyAi: An agent can assemble a bounded forecast packet and make uncertainty explicit, while the operator remains responsible for assumptions, liquidity choices, and money movement.
operatorPath: Request an updated forecast as of a date; the agent resolves accounts, commitments, weekly start convention and cashflow rules from the workspace.
Review assumptions, uncertainty, and exceptions in the selected external backend.
Use the packet to decide later operational actions; this workflow itself never moves money or commits a payment.
agentPath: Read only selected external records and optional safe Stripe balance/invoice/payment evidence.
Build a dated sequence of exactly thirteen weekly external forecast entries, preserving assumptions and uncertainty in the external backend.
Record only safe references in StackOS; deliver supported forecasts with named assumptions and gaps, or an incomplete packet when opening cash is unknown.
recovery: Separate unavailable facts from labeled scenario assumptions. Missing evidence stays visible; prepare supported components and never substitute zero for unknown cash.
If a Stripe source is unavailable, keep the packet bounded to selected available external evidence and name the resulting gap.
safeStoppingPoints: Stop with a scope/evidence-gap packet before a forecast is prepared.
Stop after a review-ready external forecast; downstream payment, transfer, or tax actions require their own workflows and authority.

handoffs.when: A separately requested tax preparation may reuse relevant forecast assumptions; a thirteen-week cash forecast never substitutes for annual taxable-income inputs or automatically starts tax work.
The forecast is blocked by an unresolved bookkeeping or reconciliation exception.

prerequisites: An external workspace with account/source register and forecast as-of date; defaults are resolved during preflight
Safe external source refs; optional restricted Stripe read access when selected
proof: External dated thirteen-week forecast ref and assumptions/uncertainty refs
Safe source/action-call proof refs, exception refs, and tax handoff ref
whenToUse: A rolling external cashflow forecast needs a bounded, dated thirteen-week refresh.

stages.title: Preflight Forecast Scope
stages.summary: Resolve a dated thirteen-week scope, external account sources and scenario conventions.

stages.title: Collect Bounded Cashflow Evidence
stages.summary: Read selected external records and optional safe Stripe balance, invoice, and invoice-payment evidence.

stages.title: Prepare External Thirteen-Week Forecast
stages.summary: Write exactly thirteen dated weekly forecast entries, assumptions, uncertainty, and exceptions only in the selected external backend.

stages.title: Review Forecast And Handoff Safely
stages.summary: Review safe external proof/uncertainty refs and hand a qualified forecast packet to tax estimates when its conditions are met.
